regime.label: Cautious, no panic
regime.summary: US futures lower (S&P -0.6%, Nasdaq -1.3%) as chips sell before Nvidia's results and the Anthropic IPO. VIX about 20.5: alert, far from panic. Stoxx 600 flat near its record.

brief: AI chips slide again before Nvidia's results Tuesday night while healthcare and Europe hold up. Today: place a limit BUY 4 Fortinet at $125; lab: NVO swing after 19:00 Dubai only in the $42.60-42.95 zone.

todo.focus: Cowboy lab starts. Max $40 loss per trade.

items.text: Alphabet: limit BUY 1 GOOGL at $288, valid until Fri Nov 20 (cancel any $300 order)
Fortinet: limit BUY 4 FTNT at $125, valid to Fri. Can be placed now
Lab: BUY 23 NVO $42.60-42.95 if above $42, stop $41.90, sell at $45.20, hold up to 3 days

cards.name: Fortinet
cards.trigger: BUY 4 with a limit at $125 (Fri close $127.22). Valid until Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: Sales +20%, billings +29%, guidance raised a third time. Down 33% in a month on AI fears around software.

cards.name: Novo Nordisk (lab swing)
cards.trigger: After 19:00 Dubai: BUY 23 at max $42.95, only if above $42. Stop $41.90, target $45.20, up to 3 days.
cards.story: New CagriSema weight-loss data at ObesityWeek. A 1-3 day swing, not a long-term buy.

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: BUY 6 with a limit at $89. Then 6 more each week while below $91.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies, 3.5% below its high. Your core holding.

cards.name: EVENT: Nvidia results Tue (call 02:00 Dubai Wed)
cards.trigger: HOLD. No new AI buy before the numbers. Act Wed after 19:00 Dubai.
cards.story: Options price a move of about 9.6%. Up >5%: hold, don't chase. Down >5%: don't panic sell, read the deep dive first. Flat: nothing to do.

cards.name: Cisco
cards.trigger: BUY Tue Nov 17 with a limit at $96 only if Monday's close is above $94.
cards.story: Record sales and raised forecast, but margin down. Part real, part mood.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: BUY 2 Tue Nov 17 with a limit at CHF 170, only if Monday closes above CHF 165.
cards.story: Net profit +39%, keeps taking share. Q2 growth slowed to +13%.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: BUY 1 with a limit at $288, valid until Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled; 28% below its high. Also benefits from the Anthropic IPO.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 with a limit at $395 if TSM holds above $385.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%. The drop is sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 10 with a limit at EUR 48.50 if above EUR 46.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips; 45% below its high.

cards.name: AMD
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 with a limit at $500. Fri close $534.
cards.story: Sales +45%, but up 19% the week before: no chase.

cards.name: Global Payments
cards.trigger: BUY 6 with a limit at $86, valid until Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: -12% when buyout talks ended. Business unchanged, about 6.5x profit.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: BUY 2 with a limit at EUR 235 (now about EUR 240).
cards.story: Organic growth +17%, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal, not demand.

cards.name: GE Vernova
cards.trigger: WATCH. 1 share (~$803) is over budget. Reconsider if above $780 through Fri.
cards.story: Orders +96%, down 20% in a month on data-center fears.

cards.name: Coca-Cola HBC
cards.trigger: WATCH. Only if Russia confirms no takeover of its units.
cards.story: -18% on a Russia seizure report the Kremlin later denied.

cards.name: EVENT: Anthropic IPO (trades Thu 19)
cards.trigger: Don't buy on day 1. Revisit if it trades back within ~5% of the IPO price.
cards.story: Range $70-78, about 6x oversubscribed. Big first-day jumps often fade.

agenda.event: US retail sales 17:30; Home Depot, Disney; Nvidia after close (call 02:00 Wed)
Fed minutes 23:00; Target, Lowe's; Palo Alto after close. TSM, IFX, AMD orders become active
Anthropic (ANT) starts trading; Walmart; Intuit after close
Sandisk first day after its 8-for-1 split
Dell, HP, Analog Devices, Autodesk, Best Buy
